decisions.reason: The prescribed row-insertion workflow does not change how Item and Title must align with the other Board Meeting fields.
The source decision concerns adding Board Meeting agenda rows, not date selection or date formatting.
The row-insertion workflow does not alter word wrapping or column containment in Indstilling text boxes.
Inserting a new agenda row instead of adding a line after a Topic does not change normal-Enter support in text-entry fields.
The source decision does not address fixed margins or pencil-icon containment in the Guidance template.
The Board Meeting row workflow has no necessary effect on bullet sizing, alignment, color, or visual design.
The instruction to insert and populate a row does not change hard-return spacing for continuous text fields.
Copying fields into a newly inserted agenda row does not modify whether placeholders clear when controls are activated.
The source establishes a specific Board Meeting agenda-row workflow, not a change to the requested Master-template table walkthrough.
The row-insertion decision does not affect the available theme-color palette.
Copying fields within a newly inserted Board Meeting row is distinct from transferring legacy document content into new templates.
The source does not address manual line breaks following legacy-content paste operations.
